sources.snippet: Clear Connect Type X: proprietary 434 MHz band, purpose-built for lighting control. 200 devices per processor (100 Type X + 100 Type A), expandable. Sunnata touch, Maestro, seeTouch keypads available. Lutron Designer programming required. 8-year component warranty.

RadioRA 3 replaced RadioRA 2 with significant upgrades: Clear Connect Type X (faster, more reliable), expanded device count, better integration options via Lutron Connect Bridge. Professional integrators consider it the definitive retrofit lighting system.

Integrators report Clear Connect Type X resolves the few interference issues that occasionally affected older Type A. 200-device limit is sufficient for most homes up to 5,000 sq ft. Larger homes use multiple processors seamlessly. seeTouch keypads provide multi-button scene control comparable to HomeWorks at lower price point.

RadioRA 3 integrates natively with Lutron shading and connects to third-party systems via Lutron Connect Bridge. Compatible with Savant, Control4, Crestron, and all major automation platforms. Also supports HomeKit, Alexa, Google Home natively.

sources.source_name: Professional Consensus — No Ketra on RadioRA
sources.snippet: Ketra tunable lighting is HomeWorks-exclusive by design — Lutron maintains this as the key differentiator justifying the HomeWorks price premium. RadioRA 3 dimming is excellent but limited to the CCT of installed fixtures.
Lutron Electronics Co. — privately held since 1961, Coopersburg PA.

bottom_line: RadioRA 3 is the best professional-grade wireless lighting control system available. Clear Connect Type X provides dedicated-band RF reliability without wired infrastructure. 200 devices per processor, expandable with multiple processors. Sunnata touch dimmers, Maestro, and seeTouch keypads offer professional aesthetics. Requires Lutron-certified installer. 8-year warranty. No Ketra support (HomeWorks exclusive). The ideal system for $1-5M homes, especially retrofits where panelized infrastructure is impractical.
